g1|variants|credit management.family_title: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management (FSCM Credit Management) Variants
g1|variants|credit management.summary: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management manages customer credit risk through different integration architectures, evaluation triggers, and scoring paths. The variants differ primarily by whether they use classic SD credit management or advanced FSCM credit management, the document types and item categories that trigger credit checks, and whether blocks are handled synchronously or asynchronously.

variants.name: FSCM Credit Management with Sales Order Block
variants.when_used: Standard OTC scenario where sales orders are checked against FSCM credit rules and blocked synchronously upon limit breach.
variants.key_config: Assign credit segment in UKM_DEBITOR, configure automatic credit check in SD pricing/sales document type, and activate credit check per credit control area.

variants.name: FSCM Credit Management with Delivery Block
variants.when_used: Scenario where credit checks are deferred until outbound delivery creation, preventing picking/shipping upon credit limit exceedance.
variants.key_config: Set credit check activation at delivery type level, configure credit representative group, and ensure schedule line category triggers credit check.

variants.name: Classic SD Credit Management (Compatibility Scope)
variants.when_used: Compatibility scope implementation using legacy SD credit management tables (S066/S067) instead of FSCM.
variants.key_config: Maintain credit control area in OVA8, assign credit limit to customer master (FD32), and configure credit check per sales document type.

variants.name: Distributed Credit Management with SD-FI/CO-PA
variants.when_used: Multi-system landscapes where credit checks are executed remotely via XI/PI or APIs from an external credit engine or central FI system.
variants.key_config: Configure SOA middleware, set up outbound/inbound enterprise services for CreditWorthinessCheckQuery and CreditCommitmentNotification.

variants.name: Automatic Credit Release via Workflow
variants.when_used: Advanced OTC setups where blocked sales orders or deliveries are automatically re-evaluated and released via SAP Workflow based on payment receipts.
variants.key_config: Configure event linkage for object BUS2030 (Sales Order) or delivery, link credit case to workflow template, and set automatic release rules on payment clearing.

compare_groups.name: Credit Architecture & Master Data
compare_groups.covers: Master data alignment, credit segment definition, and architectural selection between classic SD and FSCM.

compare_groups.name: Check Rules & Trigger Points
compare_groups.covers: Configuration of when the credit check occurs (sales order, delivery, or billing) and which check rules apply.

compare_groups.name: Blocking & Release Processing
compare_groups.covers: Handling of blocked documents, release transactions, and authorization groups.

compare_groups.name: OTC Integration & Failure Impacts
compare_groups.covers: How credit blocks impact downstream OTC processes like delivery creation, billing blocks, and KPI tracking.

g1|core|credit management|fscm credit ma.title: FSCM Credit Management with Sales Order Block
g1|core|credit management|fscm credit ma.story: Just like a store owner checks if a customer has enough money before letting them take a cart full of toys home, SAP checks if a company has a good enough credit score before letting them place a big order. In SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD), SAP Credit Management (FIN-FSCM-CR) automatically evaluates the customer's credit exposure against their assigned credit limit during sales order entry and blocks the sales order if the limit is exceeded. The order remains blocked until a credit controller reviews and releases it using SAP Credit Management worklists.
g1|core|credit management|fscm credit ma.why_business_needs_it: Companies must protect their cash flow and prevent bad debt by stopping shipments to customers who have exceeded their credit limits or have overdue invoices. Automating this check ensures sales representatives do not manually bypass financial risks while allowing credit controllers to manage risk efficiently.

modules.role: Captures the sales order, triggers the credit check via SD-FSCM integration, and receives the credit block status.
modules.hands_off_to: FIN-FSCM-CR (SAP Credit Management) for credit exposure calculation and limit evaluation.

modules.role: Maintains credit segments, credit limits, check rules, and processes credit blocks via the credit management worklist.
modules.hands_off_to: SD to release the sales order block once approved.

modules.role: Provides open item data and payment history feeds into SAP Credit Management for exposure updates.
modules.hands_off_to: FIN-FSCM-CR to update credit exposure values.

g1|core|credit management|fscm credit ma.title: FSCM Credit Management with Delivery Block
g1|core|credit management|fscm credit ma.story: Imagine a store owner who refuses to hand over the toys if the customer owes too much money from last time, but instead of a person checking a notebook, a super-fast computer helper checks the customer's wallet limit before the box is packed. In SAP S/4HANA, when an outbound delivery is created for a customer, SAP Credit Management (FIN-FSCM-CR) automatically evaluates the total credit exposure against the credit limit defined in the credit segment. If the limit is exceeded, the system sets a delivery block and stops goods issuance until an authorized credit controller releases the document.
g1|core|credit management|fscm credit ma.why_business_needs_it: Companies need to protect their financial health by ensuring goods are not shipped to customers who have exceeded their credit limits or have overdue open items. This minimizes bad debt risk while allowing automated controls to maintain sales velocity for creditworthy buyers.

modules.role: Creates the outbound delivery, triggers the credit check via SD Shipping Integration, and handles the delivery block when the credit check fails.
Maintains credit segments, credit limits, scoring rules, and evaluates credit exposure for business partners.

g1|core|credit management|classic sd cre.title: Classic SD Credit Management (Compatibility Scope)
g1|core|credit management|classic sd cre.story: Credit management protects the company from giving away goods to customers who cannot pay, just like a cautious store owner checking if a customer has enough money before letting them walk out with groceries. In SAP S/4HANA, Classic SD Credit Management directly links SD (Sales and Distribution) with FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) to evaluate customer credit limits and risk categories during sales order entry and delivery creation.
g1|core|credit management|classic sd cre.why_business_needs_it: The business needs this control to prevent financial losses from bad debts and automatically halt fulfillment when customers exceed their assigned credit limit. It protects cash flow by holding orders that require manual review and release by authorized credit controllers.

modules.role: Triggers credit checks during sales order creation and delivery processing, and holds blocked documents.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for customer open items, credit control area data, and liability updates.

modules.role: Maintains customer master credit limits, risk categories, and financial open items (AR balance).
modules.hands_off_to: SD (Sales and Distribution) with credit limit status, risk category, and release approvals.
